Acehnese–Dutch war (1599–1601) was a series of conflict between Aceh Sultanate and Dutch Republic. The war begin when Cornelis de Houtman insults the Acehnese sultan, Alauddin Ri'ayat Syah Sayyid al-Mukammal, and de Houtman also hijacked many Acehnese ships inflicted the retailation attack at Aceh coast. The conflict continued by the storming of Paulus van Caerden’s fleets and the capture of Jacob Corneliszoon van Neck forces, until the peace agreement between Dutch Republic and Aceh Sultanate.
